summary: Enhanced the pptx-xml-editing skill with specific anti-patterns and validation steps discovered during slide addition. The trace revealed critical gaps when cloning slides: forgetting to write the new slide XML to output, leaving orphaned placeholder shapes, and auto-numbering starting at wrong values. Updated SKILL.md with a dedicated slide cloning section, bullet numbering clarification, and expanded troubleshooting. Also updated references/pptx-structure.md with detailed buAutoNum schema and clone cleanup checklist.
